title: Curate starter STE approved-word dictionary data
description: Create the dictionary data file (packaged under src/limatus/data/ next to SKILL.md) with approved words, one-meaning-per-word entries, and non-approved alternatives, seeded from the ASD-STE100 approved-word list. Data-only task; checks consume it later.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Dictionary data: src/limatus/data/asd-ste100-dictionary.yml (synthetic starter seed: 33 approved words, 5 one-meaning rules, 5 technical names, 8 unapproved words with alternatives; description documents that the licensed ASD-STE100 word list is not bundled). Wired into package-data in pyproject.toml and loaded via _load_asd_dictionary().
